create_CycleGANConfig: create a CycleGANConfig builder config for a specific dataset like horse2zebra
build_CycleGAN_dataset: build a CycleGAN dataset builder with trainA, trainB, testA, testB splits for image-to-image translation
test_CycleGAN__info: test the CycleGAN dataset info method that returns features and citation metadata
test_CycleGAN__split_generators: test the CycleGAN split generators method that downloads and extracts dataset archives
summarize_CycleGAN__generate_examples: summarize the CycleGAN generate examples method that yields image records with labels
